approval_required_for: Any modification to DUT RTL, block_input, kernel start/lifecycle, connected-kernel pipeline, or a lower-layer implementation
Any change to the exact user-supplied board wrapper, AXI/DDR ABI, memory layout, compile source closure, or runtime contract
Any architecture, pipeline, major template, loader, or integration change beyond testbench-only debug-observability binding
Any change to checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, expected outputs, numeric comparison policy, tolerance, semantic testbench behavior, or Transformer-block scope
Choosing among multiple unresolved hierarchy declarations or aliases when current provenance does not establish a unique legal binding

consumes: current exact board source-closure and compute-slot ABI hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep functional_sim and all dependent board gates blocked. Do not edit the DUT, wrapper, kernel lifecycle, or lower layers. If declaration-level provenance is unavailable, route to planned_tool.vcs_compile_diagnostic_source_provenance instead of guessing or rerunning unchanged hardware.
executable_actions.rationale: The current exact log identifies the first XMRE lines and references, but a safe smallest edit still requires the declaration context, authoritative compile order, and source hashes. Extract those facts from the preserved current-run artifacts rather than guessing a hierarchy name or rerunning a lower layer. If the case analyzer cannot emit declaration-level context, the missing capability must be implemented as planned_tool.vcs_compile_diagnostic_source_provenance and this repair remains blocked.

consumes: semantic_testbench_manifest and immutable functional testbench contract
executable_actions.on_failure: Reject the patch and retain the current contamination barriers. If more than one declaration or hierarchy path remains plausible, request bounded human approval for that selection; never guess, weaken the observability contract, modify DUT behavior, or reopen a lower layer.
produces: updated generated-source compile manifest preserving the exact wrapper/source identity
executable_actions.rationale: After provenance identifies the actual declarations, repair only the generated board testbench's six unresolved debug-observability bindings or its compile-plan inclusion. Preserve required current-DAG boundary fields, token/order/lifecycle observation semantics, and all functional stimulus and golden behavior. Do not change the exact user sample wrapper or any DUT RTL; do not delete probes unless the immutable contract explicitly proves that the corresponding observation is not required.

consumes: updated generated board testbench and compile manifest
immutable checkpoint, deterministic stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, and expected outputs
executable_actions.on_failure: If XMRE recurs, return to current-board provenance extraction and do not patch hardware. If elaboration succeeds but runtime liveness, value, order, or protocol fails, use the fresh current-board trace to localize the earliest causal boundary and apply only a new bounded board-scope repair; do not promote, run higher-layer tools, or reopen lower layers without a direct contradiction.
executable_actions.rationale: The repaired generated observability source must first prove exact-board compile/elaboration and then execute the same functional simulation. This is the earliest meaningful rerun; it must not be replaced by a smoke test, simplified wrapper, static keyword check, or lower-layer replay.

consumes: immutable semantic testbench, target-model reference, numeric policy, and DUT weight-binding manifest
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the board layer in needs_repair and route the fresh real-tool trace to CCTG causal localization. Repair only the earliest proven current-layer boundary, rerun the same board layer, and do not run backend tools or reopen a certified lower layer without a hash-bound contradiction.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after the repaired exact-board functional simulation passes may its dependent current-layer gates run. This closes the board AXI/DDR layer without skipping multilayer functional, pipeline liveness, protocol, DDR roundtrip, or semantic evidence requirements.

consumes: fresh current-board VCS and dependent gate reports
executable_actions.on_failure: Leave every active contamination barrier and open retry request in force; do not promote the board layer or schedule backend/board-runtime tools.
produces: SACG repair decision and retry reconciliation record
Stage7 rerun handoff referencing fresh artifact hashes
executable_actions.rationale: The authoritative SACG truth contains eight open same-scope retry requests and active contamination barriers. The refined current-stage contract may supersede the prior repair artifact only after provenance, bounded repair, and all current-layer checks pass; rejected artifacts remain non-promotable evidence until then.

proposed_actions: Use the current compile artifact and case-VCS evidence analyzer to produce declaration-level provenance and the authoritative source-list/order hash projection before any edit.

Apply only a bounded generated-testbench/debug-observability binding repair: connect each required current-DAG probe to an actually declared legal signal or a testbench-only alias, preserving the existing semantic and observability contract; do not remove required boundary coverage.

Rerun the exact current-board VCS functional simulation and evidence analyzer with the immutable checkpoint, stimulus, reference, numeric policy, semantic testbench behavior, weight binding, and exact sample wrapper unchanged.

Only after functional_sim passes, run the dependent current board-layer multilayer, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, and board semantic gates in their declared order; do not invoke synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime, or lower-layer replay.
Record the refined repair and fresh rerun provenance in SACG, retaining the active trust barriers until all same-layer acceptance checks pass.
risks: Guessing a replacement for any *_bore reference can bind a probe to the wrong signal, hide an elaboration defect, or corrupt the current-DAG boundary trace.
Deleting the six probes merely to make VCS compile could violate the required observability contract, which already reports an invalid schema and missing current-DAG pipeline-boundary declaration.

Changing block_input, kernel_start sequencing, the connected kernel, or a downstream output module would reopen certified lower layers without a bound contradiction and would violate the current repair boundary.

Changing the exact wrapper, AXI/DDR ABI, compile source closure, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, tolerance, numeric policy, golden, or weight-consumption scope would contaminate the retry and invalidate comparisons.

Running dependent board gates or backend tools before a successful exact-board compile would produce missing or non-authoritative evidence; running a smoke or liveness path cannot replace functional semantic evidence.

The existing RTL output hash and boundary records cannot be treated as a hardware pass because the current exact-board simulation did not execute. Weight manifests and hashes on disk likewise do not prove complete current-board consumption.
